name.en: Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven
name.ja: <ruby>白<rt>はく</rt></ruby><ruby>鴉<rt>あ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>騎<rt>き</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt>し</rt></ruby>アン

text.en: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Winter Raven" monster you control; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". You can only use each effect of "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名的①②效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：向对手出示手牌的此卡可以发动。从手牌将“白鸦骑士 安”以外的1只“白鸦”怪兽特殊召唤。②：在自己・对手的主要阶段，以自己场上的1只“白鸦”怪兽为对象可以发动。将该怪兽视为永续魔法卡以表侧表示放在原本持有者的魔法与陷阱区域，从自己手牌・墓地将“白鸦骑士 安”以外的1只“白鸦”怪兽特殊召唤。
